description: A painted street scene: three figures in front, a young man in a white shirt on the left, a woman in a white sari in the centre and a young man in a white shirt on the right, walking arm in arm. A black cloth banner on two poles rises above them. Behind them a crowd of young men in light shirts, and a few helmeted figures far back. Colonial-style multi-storey buildings with arched balconies line a sunlit street. No visible text, no frame.
